ui.welcome.title: Welcome to Forge5
ui.welcome.body:
Create a project, write your code, then press F5:
it is built, launched, and its output shows up here.
ui.dbg.empty:
Set breakpoints by clicking in the margin, then click "🐞 Debug".
On PS5: gdbsrv payload (port 2159) and GDB 15+ on the PC. In PC mode: nothing else to install.
